title: Genesis 5:29-32 — Noah's birth, Lamech's years, Shem, Ham and Japheth
summary: Genesis 5:29-32 in English: Lamech names his son Noah, saying he will comfort us concerning our work and toil because of the cursed ground; Lamech lives 777 years in all; Noah at 500 begets Shem, Ham and Japheth. The name Noah is coloured green and numbered with footnote marks 1 to 4.

text.text: 29 And he called his name Noah¹, saying,
concerning our work and toil of our hands,
because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.”
30 And Lamech lived after he begat Noah²
five hundred ninety and five years,
31 And all the days of Lamech were
seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
32 And Noah ³ was five hundred years old:
and Noah ⁴ begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
